    book b

    loan l ON b.book_id = l.book_id
WHERE 
    l.return_date IS NULL OR l.return_date >= '2026-11-23'
GROUP BY 
    b.book_id, b.title
ORDER BY 
    total_loans DESC, b.book_id ASC
